name: EZSP Proxy Tap
description: The `ezsp_proxy_tap` component acknowledges frames from a Silicon Labs EZSP Zigbee network coprocessor (NCP) attached to a [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy/). The NCP resets if it gets no acknowledgement in time, so a slow or unstable network between the device and the API client can otherwise reset it.

config_entries.label: Serial Proxy ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [Serial Proxy](https://esphome.io/components/serial_proxy/) the NCP is attached to.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID to use for code generation.
